description:
Create a professional print layout map in QGIS. 

1. Load the polygon layer from '/home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_polygon.geojson' (administrative zones) and the point layer from '/home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_points.geojson' (monitoring stations). 
2. Style them so they are visually distinguishable (e.g., distinct colors). 
3. Create a new Print Layout named 'Bay Area Report' (via Project > New Print Layout). 
4. In the layout, add the following elements: 
   - A Map item showing the loaded layers. 
   - A Label item with the title 'Bay Area Monitoring Stations'. 
   - A Legend item identifying the layers. 
   - A Scale Bar item. 
5. Export the layout as a PNG image to '/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/bay_area_map.png'. 
6. Save the project as '/home/ga/GIS_Data/projects/bay_area_map.qgz' (or .qgs).
